_comment: Ordered dev.to cross-post queue. The GitHub Actions workflow posts ONE not-yet-posted item per run (weekly, Wed 14:00 UTC). Items with published:true go live immediately — safe here because they are already published on clankersupport.com. To syndicate NEW original content, add a markdown file under automation/devto/drafts/ and a queue item with published:false — it is created as a dev.to DRAFT for you to review and publish by hand. Idempotent: an item already on the account (matched by canonical_url or title) is skipped, so re-runs never double-post. Reorder freely; posting follows array order. `cover` (root-relative, absolutized against SITE_ORIGIN) becomes the dev.to cover_image; the -devto.jpg variants are pre-cropped to dev.to's 1000x420 ratio.
_sweep: 2026-08-20 clients-first sweep: queue now carries only client-facing posts (introduce the product, one feature shines vs a named alternative; install tutorials count). Removed as dev-story: cloudflare-workers-every-node-sdk-broke, shipping-an-embeddable-widget, additive-migration-almost-broke-every-login, ai-support-agent-without-rag, knowledge-base-recrawl-cdn-cache, ai-seo-audit-checklist. Held pending content fixes on the source posts (re-add after): open-source-intercom-alternatives (unverifiable citations claim), add-ai-support-agent-any-stack (web-search implication, stale WP-zip claim), 7-day-free-trial (retired showcase links, money-back-guarantee wording).
